name: dict comprehension tuple target
code: print({k: v for k, v in [('a', 1)]})

name: dict comprehension over items
code:
d = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
print({k: v for k, v in d.items()})

name: dict comprehension full
code:
print({k: v for k, v in [('a', 1), ('b', 2)]})
print({k: k * 2 for k in range(4)})
print({k: v for k, v in {'a': 1, 'b': 2}.items() if v > 1})
print({v: k for k, v in {'a': 1, 'b': 2}.items()})

name: list comprehension over items
code:
d = {'x': 1, 'y': 2}
print([k for k, v in d.items()])

name: comprehension over dict keys
code:
d = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
print([k for k in d])

name: dict comprehension over dict
code:
d = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
print({k: v * 2 for k, v in d.items()})

name: generator style comprehension single name still works
code: print([x * x for x in range(3)])

name: nested comprehension
code: print([[y for y in range(x)] for x in range(3)])

name: comprehension with two for clauses
code: print([(x, y) for x in range(2) for y in range(2)])
